requirements.RC-0080: Vedik astroloji Batı astrolojisinin üzerine sidereal fark uygulanmış basit bir kopya olmayacak.

invariants: The Vedic engine is a standalone calculation namespace and has no import or runtime dependency on calculation_core/western.
The engine consumes the shared astronomical EphemerisProvider directly and creates a VedicCalculationSnapshot rather than modifying a Western chart snapshot.
Ayanamsha is injected through a Vedic-specific versioned provider boundary; RC-0082 will bind the default Lahiri/Chitrapaksha implementation separately.
Exact TT, ephemeris source/data version and ayanamsha id/data version are preserved in the Vedic result.
Duplicate bodies, invalid ayanamsha values/provenance, ephemeris coverage violations and returned body/TT/provenance mismatch fail closed.
No device current time or network fallback is permitted in the Vedic calculation engine.
